name: c409_13_gc_manifest_read_404
covers: GC manifest read 404: a manifest the commit key names is lost from the store between a collection pass's read of the commit key and its read of the manifests; the library's mark finds the manifest missing, the closure is not ok and the pass is refused (mark-refused) with nothing listed or deleted, rather than re-listing

labels.GC: begin pass; GC: read commit key; ENV: g: open, gc: the commit-key read, then the environment step remove-unit that takes the retained manifest out, then the manifest reads (both held until it is applied) that find it missing
labels.GC manifest read 404 => abort pass, re-l: g: gc:refused:mark-refused, nothing listed and nothing deleted
